## Change and validation
Describe what changed, why, and what you checked.

## Critical documentation gaps — review before merging
Consider the project brief/PRD, scope, audience, journeys, tone and visual direction, technical/data/security details, acceptance evidence, runbook and current status where applicable.

Which documents changed, or which critical details are still missing?

**Documentation gap decision:** Document any deferral or not-applicable topic, why, and the follow-up owner or trigger. This is a reminder, not a mandatory approval or merge gate.
